authority: User-defined extraction eligibility; not scientific ground truth

allowed_sources.text_table_caption: Explicit direct CO2 uptake/loading/capacity with material and unit.
allowed_sources.figure_isotherm: Equilibrium uptake versus pressure, partial pressure, relative pressure or fugacity; CO2 series only.
allowed_sources.figure_tga_gravimetric: ONLY explicitly attributable direct CO2 uptake/loading/mass gain; preserve source baseline and denominator.
allowed_sources.process_direct: PSA/TSA/VSA/DAC/breakthrough/cyclic context ONLY with an explicitly reported DIRECT CO2 uptake/loading/working-capacity value.

excluded_metrics: feed/effluent concentration unless explicitly amount loaded by the material
percentage_rule: Accept only explicitly CO2 loading/mass gain, retaining wt%, mass%, weight%, w/w% as reported. Plain % requires unambiguous loading context. Do not infer denominator. Efficiency/conversion/removal/purity/recovery percentages are never loading.
chart_exclusions: concentration-time breakthrough without direct loading axis
inset_rule: Insets are source context only. Record their bounding box so it is masked, but never export, review, or merge inset coordinate rows with the parent chart.
precedence: Apply exclusions to the metric. A paper section called kinetics does not exclude an explicitly reported direct capacity. Non-CO2 curves stay in source pixels but are never exported.
manual_review: Uncertain species/basis/source routing remains manual_review; never promote by include_uncertain.
directness: Do not integrate breakthrough concentration, derive working capacity, subtract TGA baselines or infer pressure from concentration unless explicitly authorized and source parameters are present. This release captures directly reported values.
